category: multi-hoster (premium link generator with a free service)

free_tier.stated: A free service is advertised ('try our free service first'); no allowance is stated.

retention.stated: No storage product: files are streamed through the server to the user and are not stored there.

egress.terms: The FAQ describes a 1 gbps line shared among concurrent users and states that speed falls at peak load; it publishes no per-plan byte allowance.

interface_detail: Web generator; Chrome and Firefox extensions are listed.
chaining: Video streaming of linked files is offered on the same page.

limits.value: The host list publishes VIP daily limits per host, e.g. 1fichier.com 100.0 GB and rapidgator.net 500 links / 100.0 GB.

binding_note: No limit is published on the home page.

identity_cost.detail: A free service and a premium plan exist; the registration page answered 404 on the path tried, so the identity requirement is unverified.

reliability_note: No outage observed on the day read.
confidence_note: First-party home page; the plans and prices were not readable.

evidence.proved: a third-party list gives about EUR 7.60 per 30 days
the service streams files and does not store them
evidence.quote: Files are being streamed to server and from there, to user, not stored.

evidence.proved: the 1 gbps line is shared and per-user speed falls under load
evidence.quote: 1gbs line means when 100 people download at the same time, each of them can get a max dl speed of 10mbps.

evidence.proved: the service offers web, Windows and Android clients
evidence.quote: Web, Windows app and Android app — a single premium plan unlocks them all, with your downloads in sync.

evidence.proved: the login form accepts a username or an e-mail address
the signup page states registration is free
the vendor publishes a per-host VIP daily limit

notes: Paid price is a third-party figure. No programmatic path found: Web generator; Chrome and Firefox extensions are listed.
